chunks: What al-Shaykh—may Allah the Exalted support him—informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashyam, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the minimum of what menstruation may be. He said: “Three days, and its maximum is ten.”

key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation in the legal sense of ritual impurity
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ: three days as the minimum duration
key_terms.عَشَرَةٌ: ten days as the maximum duration

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and maximum number of days for hayd according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the minimum and maximum duration of hayd (menstruation). Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that the minimum duration is three days and the maximum is ten days, making it a foundational narration in the jurisprudence of ritual purity.
